capacity.label: Connection, rate, or budget saturation
capacity.suggested_next_action: Triage against the two-tier per-peer policy (V040-T-CONN-04); check admission vs retained ceilings and per-hour denial rates.

backoff.label: Dial or retry policy starving reconnection
backoff.suggested_next_action: Check D2 (seed sweep never re-dials a missing seed-tier peer) and D5/D6 (bootstrap_nodes persistence).

poison_queue.label: Self-addressed or stuck queue entries
poison_queue.suggested_next_action: Check D3 (self-recipient guard at enqueue, drain guard, queue-cancel route).

crypto_noise.label: Ratchet, decrypt, or envelope anomalies
crypto_noise.suggested_next_action: Classify per the RCA doctrine: identify whether the failure gates custody (it must not), whether it is device-side, and whether a session reset route exists.

ble_lane.label: BLE / proximity transport health
ble_lane.suggested_next_action: Cross-check against the farm transport-continuity priorities (mDNS, QUIC/TCP bridge, BLE sneakernet as one flow).

storage.label: Sled / persistence / degraded store
storage.suggested_next_action: Check MESSAGE-STORE-LOCK-001 (FileLoggingTree retention fixed; shared open_with_lock_retry budget) and whether the failure is stop->Start or a genuinely foreign holder.

identity_device.label: Identity or device registry anomalies
identity_device.suggested_next_action: Check the ghost-identity guards and whether a triad (peer_id/public_key/identity_id) is being derived from the wrong field.

orchestration.label: Agent-orchestration / harness process issue
orchestration.suggested_next_action: Route to the orchestration lanes doc; check whether the failure is a lane property (quota, model) or a process violation (gate skipped).
